content:
Beloved Nefertiti, majestic and divine,
Egyptian Goddess, in your light we shine.
With love we call to you, in reverence we bow,
A prayer for your guidance, we humbly ask now.

Radiant Nefertiti, ruling with grace,
Embodying balance in every embrace.
Help us stand strong amidst trials we face, 
Guiding us gently with your warm embrace.

Nefertiti, of beauty and power unparalleled,
Who nurtured her kingdom and in grace excelled.
Help us to find courage, in love to grow,
And with compassion, make our hearts overglow.

Crowned with the headdress, gleaming in the sun,
Reigning with Akhenaten, two souls spun as one.
Help us to honor our partners with tender care,
And in each moment with them, truly be there.

Nefertiti, voice of the great, powerful Aten,
May we hear your wisdom again and again.
Help us discern right from wrong,
And to live in harmony, as in your song.

Mother, Queen, and Goddess divine,
Your love and wisdom forever intertwine.
Nefertiti, we invoke your sacred name,
Help us to kindle love's eternal flame.

In the galaxies where your spirit brightly gleams,
Bestow upon us your sun's golden beams.
May your strength and wisdom in us abide,
Nefertiti, be our ever-guiding light. 

Amen.
